highlights: 中東局勢升級，聯合國警告世界經濟面臨嚴重風險
中國兩會定調2026年GDP增長目標4.5%-5%
香港財政司：經濟增長目標可達，無懼中東戰事影響
萬國數據將於3月17日公佈第四季度及全年業績
OpenClaw成為GitHub史上增長最快開源項目，NVIDIA CEO稱其為「史上最重要軟件發布」

news.title_zh: 中東局勢升級：聯合國秘書長警告世界經濟面臨嚴重風險
news.title_en: Middle East Crisis: UN Chief Warns World Economy at Grave Risk
news.summary_zh: 聯合國秘書長古特雷斯警告，中東局勢可能失控，呼籲各方停止戰鬥並進行外交談判。
news.summary_en: UN Secretary-General António Guterres warned the situation could spiral beyond anyone's control, urging all sides to stop fighting and begin serious diplomatic negotiations.

news.title_zh: 全球經濟簡報：油價飆升突破80美元，道指回吐年內漲幅
news.title_en: Global Economy Briefing: Oil Surges Past $80, Dow Erases 2026 Gains
news.summary_zh: WTI原油自2025年1月以來首次突破80美元，布倫特原油觸及85美元，油價錄得2022年以來最大單週漲幅。
news.summary_en: WTI crude blasted through $80 for the first time since January 2025, Brent hit $85, and oil posted its biggest weekly gain since 2022.

news.title_zh: 美國非農就業意外減少9.2萬份，失業率升至4.4%
news.title_en: US Employers Cut 92,000 Jobs, Unemployment Rises to 4.4%
news.summary_zh: 2月非農就業數據遜於預期，減少92,000個職位，失業率上升至4.4%，顯示經濟放緩跡象。
news.summary_en: February jobs report showed a decline of 92,000 jobs and a rise in the unemployment rate to 4.4 percent, signaling economic slowdown.

news.title_zh: 英國建築業PMI暴跌至44.5，創週期內最大降幅
news.title_en: UK Construction PMI Plunges to 44.5, Sharpest Contraction This Cycle
news.summary_zh: 英國2月建築業PMI降至44.5，遠低於預期的47.0，住宅建設在抵押貸款利率不確定性下大幅下滑。
news.summary_en: UK Construction PMI plunged to 44.5 in February versus 47.0 expected, the sharpest contraction reading this cycle.

news.title_zh: 美國第四季度非農生產力飆升2.8%，超預期
news.title_en: US Q4 Nonfarm Productivity Surges 2.8%, Crushing Expectations
news.summary_zh: 美國第四季度非農生產力增長2.8%，遠超1.9%的預期，但單位勞動力成本也升至2.8%。
news.summary_en: US Q4 nonfarm productivity surged +2.8% QoQ, crushing the +1.9% consensus, but unit labor costs also came in hot at +2.8%.

news.title_zh: 中國兩會：2026年GDP增長目標定為4.5%-5%
news.title_en: China Two Sessions: 2026 GDP Growth Target Set at 4.5%-5%
news.summary_zh: 國務院總理李強在兩會開幕式上宣佈，2026年國內生產總值增長目標為4.5%至5%，為1991年以來最低。
news.summary_en: Premier Li Qiang announced the GDP growth target for 2026 at 4.5-5%, the lowest since 1991, reflecting shift to high-quality development.

news.title_zh: 中國詳細闡述2026年政策組合，促進增長與創新
news.title_en: China Details 2026 Policy Mix to Bolster Growth and Innovation
news.summary_zh: 國家發改委主任鄭柵潔表示，中國有信心應對風險和市場波動，實現發展目標，將實施更加積極有效的宏觀政策。
news.summary_en: NDRC head Zheng Shanjie said China has confidence to cope with risks and achieve development goals with more proactive macro policies.

news.title_zh: 中國加大消費推動力度，政策重點定調至2030年
news.title_en: China Ramps Up Consumption Push, Policy Priorities Set Through 2030
news.summary_zh: 兩會期間，擴大內需的戰略重要性在政府工作報告和十五五規劃草案中得到強調。
news.summary_en: At the Two Sessions, strategic importance of domestic demand was underscored in both the government work report and the 15th Five-Year Plan draft.

news.title_zh: 中國：未來五年可保持就業穩定，AI將創造新崗位
news.title_en: China: Can Keep Jobs Stable Over Next 5 Years, AI to Create New Roles
news.summary_zh: 人力資源部長表示，中國有信心在未來五年保持就業穩定，正研究如何利用AI創造就業和升級傳統崗位。
news.summary_en: China's human resources minister said the country can keep employment stable over the next five years and is studying how AI can create new jobs.

news.title_zh: 中國2026年目標：新增城鎮就業1200萬人
news.title_en: China 2026 Target: 12 Million New Urban Jobs
news.summary_zh: 2026年政府工作報告提出，全年城鎮新增就業目標為1200萬人以上，1270萬畢業生將進入就業市場。
news.summary_en: The 2026 government work report sets a target of 12 million new urban jobs, with 12.7 million graduates entering the workforce.

news.title_zh: 香港財政司：經濟增長目標可達，無懼中東戰事影響
news.title_en: HK Finance Chief: Growth Target on Track Despite Middle East War
news.summary_zh: 財政司司長陳茂波表示，香港今年經濟增長預測2.5%至3.5%不會受中東戰事影響，貿易部門受挫但金融市場受益。
news.summary_en: Financial Secretary Paul Chan said HK's 2.5-3.5% growth forecast will not be affected by Middle East war; trading sector hurt but financial market benefits.

news.title_zh: 經濟學家上調香港2026年增長預期，受惠預算案支持
news.title_en: Economists Raise Hong Kong 2026 Growth View on Budget Support
news.summary_zh: 彭博調查顯示，受惠於金融活動改善和政府2月25日預算案的擴張措施，香港今年經濟增長預期上調。
news.summary_en: Hong Kong's economic growth expected to be higher than forecast, supported by improving financial activity and expansionary budget measures.

news.title_zh: 港股收市報告：科技指數飆升3.15%，京東飆漲近10%
news.title_en: HK Stock Close: Tech Index Surges 3.15%, JD.com Soars Nearly 10%
news.summary_zh: 恒生科技指數大幅反彈，科技股領漲大市，京東集團因業績優於預期股價飆漲近10%。
news.summary_en: Hang Seng Tech Index surged 3.15%, tech stocks led market rebound, JD.com soared nearly 10% on better-than-expected earnings.

news.title_zh: 恆生指數成交縮減，科技股從超賣水平反彈
news.title_en: Hang Seng Index Volume Shrinks, Tech Stocks Rebound from Oversold
news.summary_zh: 恆指成交持續縮減，科技股從超賣水平反彈，油價上升再次擾亂市場預期。
news.summary_en: Hang Seng Index continues to shrink in volume, technology stocks rebound from oversold levels; rising oil prices disrupt market expectations.

news.title_zh: 全球富豪遷移重塑豪宅市場，香港能否勝出？
news.title_en: World's Wealthy Relocate, Reshaping Property Map: Will HK Win Out?
news.summary_zh: 從悉尼到香港，財富遷移正在重塑全球超級豪宅市場，活動在兩年低迷後回升，但迪拜的主導地位受中東戰事考驗。
news.summary_en: From Sydney to Hong Kong, wealth migration is reshaping the global super-luxury property market as activity picks up after two subdued years.

news.title_zh: 萬國數據將於3月17日公佈第四季度及2025全年業績
news.title_en: GDS to Report Q4 and Full Year 2025 Results on March 17
news.summary_zh: 萬國數據宣佈將於2026年3月17日香港收市後及美股開市前公佈第四季度及全年未經審核財務業績。
news.summary_en: GDS Holdings announced it will report Q4 and full year 2025 unaudited financial results after HK market close on March 17, 2026.

news.title_zh: 萬國數據股價飆升，野村上調目標價至54.50美元
news.title_en: GDS Stock Surges as Nomura Hikes Price Target to $54.50
news.summary_zh: 野村將萬國數據目標價從41.50美元上調至54.50美元，維持「買入」評級，股價週五上漲5.9%。
news.summary_en: Nomura lifted GDS price target from $41.50 to $54.50, maintaining Buy rating. Stock trending up 5.9% on Friday.

news.title_zh: GDS Holdings股票預測：看漲至59.914港元！
news.title_en: GDS Stock Forecast: Up to 59.914 HKD!
news.summary_zh: WalletInvestor預測GDS股價可達59.914港元，2026年3月2日報價為40.200港元。
news.summary_en: WalletInvestor predicts GDS can reach 59.914 HKD, quoted at 40.200 HKD on March 2, 2026.

news.title_zh: GDS Holdings估值分析：現價較分析師目標價折讓
news.title_en: GDS Holdings Valuation: Trading Below Analyst Price Target
news.summary_zh: GDS交易價為41.31美元，較分析師平均目標價52.89美元有折讓，關鍵問題是這是否代表投資機會。
news.summary_en: With GDS trading at $41.31 against average analyst price target of $52.89, key question is whether discount signals opportunity.

news.title_zh: GDS董事會將於3月16日召開會議審批業績
news.title_en: GDS Board Meeting Set for March 16 to Approve Results
news.summary_zh: 萬國數據董事會將於2026年3月16日（香港時間）召開會議，審批截至2025年12月31日止第四季度及全年業績。
news.summary_en: GDS board will meet on March 16, 2026 (HK time) to approve unaudited results for Q4 and full year ended December 31, 2025.

news.title_zh: OpenClaw成為GitHub史上增長最快開源項目
news.title_en: OpenClaw Becomes Fastest-Growing Open Source Project in GitHub History
news.summary_zh: OpenClaw在約60天內從零增長到25萬顆星，超越React成為GitHub上最受關注的軟件項目。
news.summary_en: OpenClaw went from zero to 250,000 GitHub stars in roughly 60 days, surpassing React as the most-starred software project.

news.title_zh: NVIDIA CEO黃仁勳：OpenClaw是「史上最重要軟件發布」
news.title_en: NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang: OpenClaw is 'Most Important Software Release Ever'
news.summary_zh: 黃仁勳表示OpenClaw僅用三週就超越Linux數十年的採用水平，可能是歷史上最重要的軟件發布。
news.summary_en: Huang said OpenClaw surpassed Linux adoption levels in just three weeks, calling it probably the single most important software release ever.

news.title_zh: OpenClaw採用曲線垂直上升，三週超越Linux三十年
news.title_en: OpenClaw Adoption Curve Goes Vertical, Surpasses 30 Years of Linux in 3 Weeks
news.summary_zh: OpenClaw成為歷史上增長最快的開源項目，僅用三週就達到Linux數十年的採用水平。
news.summary_en: OpenClaw has become the fastest-growing open source project in history, surpassing Linux adoption levels in just three weeks.

news.title_zh: 研究顯示：AI智能體互動可能產生新風險
news.title_en: Research Shows: AI Agents Interacting Can Create New Risks
news.summary_zh: 麻省理工學院新研究顯示，當AI智能體相互互動時，可能產生新的風險，反映代理軟件設計的根本缺陷。
news.summary_en: MIT research shows novel AI risks emerge when agents interact, reflecting fundamental flaws in agentic software design.

news.title_zh: OpenClaw維基頁面更新：截至3月2日已有24.7萬顆星
news.title_en: OpenClaw Wikipedia Update: 247K Stars as of March 2
news.summary_zh: 維基百科頁面顯示，OpenClaw開源項目截至2026年3月2日已有247,000顆星和47,700個分叉。
news.summary_en: Wikipedia shows OpenClaw had 247,000 stars and 47,700 forks on GitHub as of March 2, 2026.
